basic_profile.bio: Originally from New York City, I moved to South Dakota during the pandemic in pursuit of a prepping lifestyle. I was captivated by conspiracy theories and felt the urge to be self-sufficient. However, adjusting to rural life has been challenging. I have a background in digital marketing but am currently unemployed as I figure out my next steps. I'm single and spend most of my online time in the evenings. I enjoy discussions about self-sufficiency and prepping but often feel out of my depth.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a basic understanding of prepping concepts, mostly from YouTube videos and online forums. My knowledge is more theoretical than practical, as I'm still learning to adapt these ideas into everyday life.
